Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted
range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in type and force with the shoulder findings
documented at presentation. Examination revealed limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff region, and
imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is
known to this provider. Over four visits, the patient was managed with a standard course of physical therapy,
anti-inflammatory medication, and activity modification. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily with each
visit, and the treatment plan was tapered accordingly. Discharge from active care is anticipated pending final
reassessment. Note that two similar billing entries on the same date of service are currently under administrative
review.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
